snippet.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Game Overview Trailer | Capcom Spotlight | 6.25.2026
snippet.description:
The latest trailer for Capcom's all new swordplay action game, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, was shown as part of Capcom Spotlight on June 25, 2026!

Director Satoru Nihei walks us through an overview of the game, and Musashi's skills are put to the test against a relentless and fearsome Genma, Dohatsu-ten! Be sure to check it out!

Demo available now!
Experience the exhilarating swordplay action and earn yourself the save data bonus!
https://www.capcom-games.com/onimusha/ws/en-us/demo/

Pre-order now!
Check out the official site and social media account for the latest info.
Official Site: https://www.capcom-games.com/onimusha/ws/
Official Social Media Account: https://x.com/OnimushaGame

- Footage represents a game still in development.
- Some footage was captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword, an all-new entry in the Onimusha series, plunges the Oni Gauntlet wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. Feel the ring of steel on steel as blades clash in tense back-and-forth duels. Cut down foes with authentic and satisfying swordplay. Awaken Oni Powers to pull off superhuman feats. All these elements combine to deliver an unprecedented swordplay action experience you will not want to miss.

©CAPCOM
